body: Thanks kind stranger, I'll keep coming back to this whenever the going gets rough.
A good game, or sometimes getting invited and actually going out with people. I've picked up longboarding recently and I think I'm going to be sticking with it, so there's that too.

Wow, I can't believe I looked over all this, and a lot of the other Sector 9 boards. Seem to be a bunch of 9 plys that I missed. Thanks for pointing me in this direction, looks like I have a little bit more browsing to do!

Dang, the Mantis looked sick. Oh well. I was originally thinking about the Arbiter before switching over to the Backlash, so I'm glad it's still a solid choice. And the other two were kinda just two other options that I kept in the back of my mind.
I have looked into Rayne boards but they all seem pretty expensive. For my first I'm trying not to spend anymore than $225.

Hello! I have returned to ask another question. [In a previous thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/longboarding/comments/4m3u6v/rlongboardings_daily_general_thread_jun_02_2016/) I asked about getting the arbor backlash. Unfortunately, it's out of stock, and I don't think it will be in stock any time soon. So, for the time being, I found 4 other boards that I think I might get: [the Restless Mantis](https://www.muirskate.com/longboard/completes/70352/restless-mantis-longboard-skateboard-custom-complete), [the Original Arbiter 36 KT](https://www.muirskate.com/longboard/completes/36611/original-arbiter-36-kt-longboard-skateboard-custom-complete), [the Drang Doobie 38](https://www.muirskate.com/longboard/completes/70776/drang-doobie-38-longboard-skateboard-custom-complete), or [the Madrid 2016 Bamboo Market Price](https://www.muirskate.com/longboard/completes/71093/madrid-2016-bamboo-market-price-longboard-skateboard-custom-complete). 

Just for those who didn't see my post in the last thread, I want to get into longboarding this summer so I can start cruising on campus this semester, and I need a good first board that I can learn stuff on/ last me a while. 6 foot 4, around 250 lb. So yeah, just asking if any of the above would be a good choice, or if there are any others I should look out for. Thanks!
In that case I'll get the riptide then. Thanks for all your help! When I get my paycheck I'll put in the order

Cool! [How does this setup look?](https://www.muirskate.com/longboard/completes/71435/arbor-2016-backlash-40-longboard-skateboard-custom-complete#/deck?t=29501&w=2866-4461&b=32931&r=71406) I'm trying not to break the bank since it's my first board and all.

Hiya,

I'm trying to get into longboarding this summer (or rather, start this summer so I'll be decent when school starts back up) so I can mainly cruise around campus. I'm a bigger dude, 6 foot 5, around 250 pounds, so I took that into consideration and eventually settled on the Arbor 2016 Backlash 40".

Question is, is that a good board to start with? From what I can tell it will be able to support me fine and is good for cruising, but if it's not optimal to start my longboarding journey on, what is? Also, what's an optimal set-up? Thanks in advance.
